name: Acrobatic
text: While Active the fighter can pass through enemy fighters during Move (Simple) and Charge (Double) actions, though the 1 inch rule applies where it stops. Barricades and similar features up to 2 inches high cost it nothing extra to cross.

name: Combat Focus
text: +1 Willpower and +1 Cool for each enemy fighter that is Out of Action or Seriously Injured (a natural 2 still fails).

name: Combat Virtuoso
text: Knives, stiletto knives, stiletto swords, power knives, power swords and chainswords in this fighter's hands gain Versatile, with reach equal to its Strength.

name: Hit and Run
text: Following a Charge (Double) and ahead of the enemy's reaction attacks, the fighter makes a free Retreat (Basic) action. If that works, the opponent gets only one set of reaction attacks.

name: Lightning Reflexes
text: Once each round, while Engaged and before an enemy attacks, the fighter makes a free Retreat (Basic) action. A Ready fighter can still be activated afterwards.

name: Somersault
text: Basic action: put the fighter at any spot within 6 inches in line of sight that is more than 1 inch from every enemy. It is not treated as movement for effects that trigger on movement.
